what: The real rating gap between the two players against the gap the model predicts, on the held-out test partition.
sources: CCS Thesis - Integrated/chapters/chapter4.tex (agreement between the White and Black estimates)
method: The per-side prediction is the true rating plus the recorded signed error. Summary statistics and the error-above-threshold curve use all 255,000 games; only the scatter is a random subsample.

predicted_gap.note: Sizes of the gap, so the absolute White minus Black difference, matching analysis/side-mirroring-results.md.
